title: Batch runner skips a lane whose get_session shows unarchived_epoch above 0
why: merge --idle-lanes (#3108) holds an unarchived lane only when the live file carries unarchived_epoch on its row. The 02:26 CST file carries it on 1 of 1700 rows. Expected harm: the owner unarchives lane X, X is not on keepSessions, the report lists X, and the runner archives it again. That is the original incident.
source: lane merge-runs-idle-lanes, round 3 limit 1, 02:56 CST Nov 13
note: Two parts. (a) Triage writes unarchived_epoch from get_session on each idle lane row at each live-file refresh. (b) One sentence in decision session-tiers, plus the runner's archive step: the runner already runs get_session on each lane line alone before archiving, and it skips a lane whose ccr.external_metadata.unarchived_epoch is above 0. (b) closes the gap without the file. Guard-adjacent: goes to a lane.
